subject: LatticeTech payflow setup — bank proof + PO labeling guidance
messages:
From: Elena Marquez <elena@latticetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: LatticeTech onboarding package and bank details

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our vendor onboarding package and a CSV with the bank account stubs for the account we want to link to purchase orders from Redwood. We can accept ACH (USD) and same-day wires — routing and account are for the US entity (EIN on the form).

Quick notes: 
- Preferred remittance reference: please include the invoice number and your PO ID in the format "INV12345 | PO: <your PO#>" so our AR system picks up vouchers automatically.
- Our team uses vendor-portal@vendorhub.com for portal confirmations if you need a test.

Attachments: Lattice_Vendor_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf (we'll sign once you confirm the onboarding portal record), latticetech_bank_stubs.csv

Let me know if you need a W-9 or additional proof of bank ownership.

Thanks,
Elena Marquez
Finance Operations
LatticeTech, Inc.
elena@latticetech.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@latticetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LatticeTech onboarding package and bank details

Elena — thanks, got it. A couple of quick asks so we can move this through Finance and PayOps: 

1) Please attach the signed onboarding PDF (we need the signature page), or confirm if you prefer DocuSign — we can send that link.
2) Confirm whether the bank account is a checking account (routing number used for ACH). Our micro-deposit flow requires a checking account confirmation.
3) Can you confirm the exact remittance text your AR system expects (you mentioned "INV12345 | PO: <your PO#>"); if there is an alternate token (e.g., vendor reference or remit code) please provide it so we can map the PO label.

Ben/Priyom/Jonas — looping you in to validate the stub and confirm the PO->vendor mapping step in the procurement system. Priyom, can PayOps create a vendor record with temporary hold until micro-deposits are validated? Jonas, I'll need the vendor ID once you create it so I can map incoming POs.

If you prefer, we can also accept a signed W-9 via the portal link below.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0124

From: Elena Marquez <elena@latticetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LatticeTech Finance <payments@latticetech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LatticeTech onboarding package and bank details

Marissa — attaching the signed onboarding form and a cleaned CSV with the bank proof.

We confirm:
- Account type: Checking
- ACH: Yes (USD) — routing #: 123456789; account #: 987654321 (see CSV for formatted stubs)
- Wire: accept (same-day wires for payments above $5k)
- Remittance token: We prefer exactly "INV{inv}|PO:{po}" (no spaces around the pipe) — our AR tokenizer splits on "|". Example: "INV12345|PO:67890".

Attachments: [Attachment: Lattice_Vendor_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: latticetech_bank_stubs.csv (CSV)]

Once you confirm the vendor record creation and micro-deposit schedule, I'll watch for the two deposits and confirm in the portal.

Best,
Elena
Finance Operations
LatticeTech, Inc.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: LatticeTech onboarding package and bank details

Marissa/Jonas/Priyom — I created the vendor record (Vendor ID: VND-88214) and queued the ACH micro-deposits to the account Elena provided. Expected behavior: two small deposits within 1-2 business days (typically $0.08 and $0.13 on our sandbox flow). Priyom, please hold the vendor for payments until the micro-deposit confirmation comes back.

Action items and notes for PO integration: 
- Jonas: map VND-88214 to procurement supplier code SLP-478 so incoming POs with SLP-478 route to this vendor record.
- Marissa: when you send the initial PO to LatticeTech, add our internal PO label in the body and ensure the PO line includes their vendor code (SLP-478). Ex: PO-2026-2247 (label) -> send to supplier with invoice instruction exactly "INV{inv}|PO:{po}" so their AR tokenization succeeds.
- Elena: watch for two micro-deposits and confirm amounts via the vendor portal link (https://vendorhub.example.com/portal/verify/LP-47821). Once confirmed, we'll flip the vendor to active and remove the payment hold.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
